build_lidar_3d_boxes: build a python module to create LiDARInstance3DBoxes from a tensor of x, y, z, dims, and yaw values
compute_gravity_center: compute the gravity center of LiDAR 3D boxes by offsetting the bottom center along the z axis
compute_box_corners: compute the 8 corner coordinates of each LiDAR 3D box in clockwise order with rotation applied
rotate_lidar_boxes: rotate LiDAR 3D boxes and optional points by a given angle around the z axis
flip_lidar_boxes: flip LiDAR 3D boxes horizontally or vertically in BEV and optionally flip associated points
